invariants.description: Quorum threshold is immutable at construction; runtime reduction is a constitutional violation.
Each registered agent must cast exactly one typed vote per round; duplicate or missing votes are fatal.
HUMAN-0 veto immediately terminates the round as BLOCKED; HUMAN-0 override as APPROVED. Neither can be contested by any agent.
Every consensus event is HMAC-chained to its predecessor; chain break is a fatal constitutional violation.
Committed consensus records are append-only; no mutation or deletion is permitted post-commit.
An unresolved CHALLENGE vote blocks quorum; must be withdrawn or escalated to HUMAN-0 before consensus can pass.
Consensus evaluation is deterministic; identical vote sets must yield identical outcomes.
Every vote, resolution, and quorum decision is logged before the caller receives a response.
A mutation's registered scope paths are immutable once the consensus round is opened.
No mutation may advance to the CEL gate without a PASSED consensus record; bypass is a Hard-class constitutional violation.
